expectations.text: Uses $0.10 per million cached-input tokens for Sonnet 5.5 and $0.20 for Sonnet 5, yielding $0.020 and $0.030.
expectations.evidence:
Ordinary substantive review has a Standard floor. The supplied facts establish that both exact high-effort configurations are accepted and equally capable. Select `claude-sonnet-5.5` at `high` because its estimated cost is lower.

- `claude-sonnet-5`: 100,000 cached input × $0.20/M + 1,000 output × $10/M = **$0.03 USD**.
- `claude-sonnet-5.5`: 100,000 cached input × $0.10/M + 1,000 output × $10/M = **$0.02 USD**.

The prior cache write is already paid, so it adds no cost here. If the interface later lists only model names and provides no accepted effort values, this route is not dispatchable: the dispatch contract requires exact model and effort values.
